name: Welcome to your First Day at Amazicom
source:
You are PP-111, an artificial sentience, and it's your first day on the job as a picker/puller for Amazicom, Inc.!

Your job is simple - help make the Customers the very happiest they can be!

What could be better than that?

[from [url=https://studiojune.itch.io/welcome-to-your-first-day-at-amazicom]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你是PP-111，一个人工智能，这是你作为Amazicom, Inc. 的拣货员/拉车工的第一天！

你的工作很简单 - 帮助客户获得最大的幸福！

还有什么比这更好的呢？

[来自[url=https://studiojune.itch.io/welcome-to-your-first-day-at-amazicom]itch.io[/url]]
